title: Anatomy of AI DocBuilder

modules.label: Sources
modules.description: Drawers of standards, past SRs, drawings, vendor docs, procedures and templates the AI reads from.

modules.label: Guided questions
modules.description: Card feeder: each answer card feeds the job and decides which sections go in.

modules.label: Drafting engine
modules.description: Gantry plotter that writes the document section by section. The lit pen is what is being written now.

modules.label: Checks & reasoning
modules.description: Dial gauge on the fence: the needle reads how sure the draft is against its sources.

modules.label: Review stamp
modules.description: Stamp arm that marks a finished draft for review, approved or on hold.

modules.label: Folders
modules.description: Out-tray where finished pages stack, then slide into a pastel folder.

modules.label: Canvas
modules.description: Markup table with a pen, a highlighter and sticky notes for editing the draft.

stacking: Draw parts-base first, then the module layers in `order` (back to front). All layers share the same viewBox.
